sae_families.definition: sum over the family's member SAE features of the frozen SAE's last-window activation, added across layers

crystallization_norm.definition: log(L2 norm of the last-window residual state + 1e-12)

concept_structure.exploratory_not_registered: 'convergent concepts outnumber shared ones among multi-model concepts' is exploratory, not registered: it is low-powered at ~16 multi-model concepts and its classes come from a union-find over input-agreement pairs that has no private counterpart (sec 38.2.2 item 4c).
concept_structure.target_gate: not applied: the structure claims are panel-level aggregates, not claims about any one target's features. (b) is a rate over ALL scorable dev candidates at every measured target, so restricting it to targets selected for having MORE clears than chance would condition on the outcome and bias the causally-null rate downward; (a) is a claim about the frozen pooled atlas as a whole, and dropping a target's features from that pool would change the claim, not test it. Both stay as registered; the per-target table is still computed (and a missing `empirical_chance` still refuses) because the gate is a property of the whole registration.

not_registered.families_beat_shuffle_null: 'families do not beat the shuffle null' is a NEGATIVE structure result: confirming a null needs an equivalence margin that nobody has justified (sec 38.2.2 item 5). It stays descriptive.
